surfaces.title: Solnest AI - Watch What Happens When AI Meets Your Business

findings.title: Five pages are canonicalised to the homepage, blocking AI retrieval
findings.description: Google AI Overviews and AI Mode retrieve from the ordinary Search index. /about, /services, /work, /book and /webinar all declare https://solnestai.com as canonical, so they are not eligible to be retrieved or cited. Verified against raw HTML.
findings.recommendation: Emit self-referencing canonicals. This is the single highest-leverage fix for both search and AI visibility.

findings.title: Nothing on the site is quotable
findings.description: Main-content extraction yields 479 words from 1,921. The longest paragraph is 37 words against a 134 to 167 word target, with zero paragraphs over 40 words. Extractable text contains 0 percentages and 0 dollar figures. A model can read the page and has nothing to lift and attribute.
findings.recommendation: Add two or three genuine 130 to 160 word answer blocks with real numbers. Published pricing is the most quotable asset available and is absent from extractable text.

findings.title: Only two of eight homepage H2s are question-form
findings.description: Question-shaped headings match how people phrase prompts and how retrieval segments a page.
findings.recommendation: Convert several H2s to the questions buyers actually ask.

findings.title: AI search crawler access is correctly configured
findings.description: All four search crawlers are allowed in robots.txt and return 200 at the edge. The robots.txt correctly separates search crawlers from training crawlers, which most sites get wrong.
findings.recommendation: No action. Keep OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and Googlebot allowed.

findings.title: Brand entity is consistent across all machine-readable surfaces
findings.description: Solnest AI is byte-identical across title, og:site_name, both JSON-LD blocks and llms.txt. No entity split.
findings.recommendation: No action. Keep the name byte-identical when adding directory listings or a Google Business Profile.
